convertibility_reason: Uses only standard MT5 trade library classes (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo, CAccountInfo) and no custom indicators. Simple random entry with fixed SL/TP in points. No external logic libraries. Straightforward single-position management.

other_exits: Position flat detection via CPositionInfo.Select() - exits when position volume reaches zero or position no longer exists, indicating SL or TP was hit

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal is a coin toss using MathRand(): values < 16384 (out of 32767 max) go long, values >= 16384 go short (~50/50 probability). The EA only enters when not already in a position (Running=false). After entry, it waits for the position to close (via SL/TP hit) before attempting a new entry. ReallyRandom input controls whether the RNG is seeded with current time (true) or a fixed seed of 1 (false) for reproducible backtests. OnInit blocks execution on real accounts with a MessageBox warning.
python_conversion_notes: Very simple to convert. No indicators to replicate. Replace MathRand() coin toss with Python random.random() < 0.5. Replace CTrade.PositionOpen with broker API market order. Replace CPositionInfo.Select with position query. SL/TP are in points (Points * StopLoss, Points * ProfitTarget) - convert to price offset in Python. The Running flag enforces single-position sequential trading. Deviation/slippage param of 30 points maps to slippage tolerance in API calls. The ReallyRandom flag just controls RNG seeding - use random.seed() accordingly.
